rules: Only Robinhood-confirmed stock fills and exits may set reconciledFromRobinhood=true.
A trade may influence adaptive live ranking only after the position is closed, the outcome is WIN/LOSS/FLAT, and realizedR is finite.
Never invent missing fills, prices, quantities, order ids, slippage, or exit reasons.
Keep shadow/model outcomes separate from this real-money journal.
Adaptive learning may reorder already-qualified candidates or reduce/block risk, but may never increase maximum live risk or loosen hard safety gates.

Fixed 2026-08-23: prior to this date, no automated step ever created an OPEN entry here at buy time (only the exit side was instructed to write here), so this journal stayed empty despite live positions and permanently capped stocks at SHADOW_ONLY regardless of real performance. The scheduled Teststock execution-check now creates an OPEN entry at confirmed-fill time and reconciles OPEN entries against live Robinhood data on every run, independent of whether the current run's own trigger-board shows an exit event for that ticker.

Added 2026-08-26, expanded 2026-08-26: a seedLane=true entry originated from the user-authorized stock seed lane (docs/data/probability-first-policy.json stocks.seedLane), which still required its own explicit per-order user approval -- it is never auto-submitted. Each OPEN entry with seedLane===true occupies one of up to maxConcurrentPositions (currently 5) concurrent seed slots, each capped at maxOrderUsd (currently $5). At the user's explicit request this no longer pauses after stopped trades: a symbol with a seedLane===true entry whose outcome=LOSS and exitReason=STOP with finalExitAt today (UTC) is excluded from being re-selected as a new seed candidate for the rest of that UTC day, but the seed lane itself keeps running and rotates to the next distinct eligible candidate. The scheduled execution-check must recompute both (open seedLane===true tickers, and today's STOP-closed seedLane===true tickers) live before ever presenting a new seedLaneCandidates entry for approval, and must never exceed maxConcurrentPositions concurrently open seed positions.

Added 2026-09-17: a seed-lane fill executed directly from an interactive session (not the scheduled automated executor) must still be reconciled into this journal at fill time -- otherwise seedLane.openedSeedPositionsToday/currentOpenSeedPositions undercounts against live reality in every subsequently published dispatch, and a later cycle can publish a second same-day SEED_LANE_BUY_TRIGGER that would exceed maxNewPositionsPerUtcDay if executed. Reconcile from live Robinhood positions/orders, not just this file, before ever executing a seed-lane candidate.

Added 2026-09-18: a closed position's exit must be reconciled here at close time, not just in execution-watchlist.json -- the RPRX stop-loss close on 2026-09-11 was recorded in execution-watchlist.json but never propagated here, leaving this journal's summary (0 resolved trades, $0 realized PnL) silently wrong for a week. Also added BNS and ILMN, pre-existing manual Robinhood positions the user explicitly brought under Teststock monitoring; their plannedStop/target1/target2 were computed retroactively from live technicals since no Teststock signal ever existed for them.
